verdict.rationale: Adyen docs describe a 'standalone terminal solution' as 'the quickest way to accept in-person payments' plus Customer Area/Management API tools to register and manage terminals (docs-3, docs-4, docs-11, docs-17), suggesting fast setup is possible. However a first-hand community account describes integrating Adyen's card-present readers as requiring 'hundreds of hours' before the team ultimately abandoned it, directly contradicting the 'within minutes' ease claim for full POS/API integration. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that the standalone/basic pairing flow (not full API integration) is actually minutes-fast, and no rebuttal to the negative community report.
